scope: read-only direct CAS proof, no benchmark inference
invariant: published shared peak only grows; mode fixed; init/recovery resets before publication
success: CAS sets c only while c>expected, strictly increases peak
failure: returned q<c retries, q>=c exits; spurious equal returned old retries. No numeric ABA because shared peak cannot decrease.
occupancy: capture original occupied.fetchAdd result, never re-read occupied as replacement count
ordering: all original peak operations monotonic; no publication synchronization role changed
possible_codegen_cost: optional atomic cmpxchg result may create tag/spill or count arithmetic path changes; inspect actual assembly first
